senses.gloss: f. (פלל to be round, roll) ball, grain, esp. pepper.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 6:5">Sabb. VI, 5</cite> (<cite ref="Shabbat 64b">64ᵇ</cite>) <he>בפ׳ ובגרגיר מלח</he> with a grain of pepper (Rashi: a bit of ‘long pepper’) or a grain of salt (in the mouth); ib. 65ᵃ <he>פ׳ לריח הפה</he> pepper (is put in the mouth) to dispel the bad odor &c. Ib. IX, 6 (90ᵃ) <he>פלפלת כל שהו</he> any quantity of (long) pepper; a. e.—Pl. <he>פִּלְפָּלִין</he>, <cite ref="Q01111"><he>פִּילְ׳</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Berakhot 36b:5">Ber. 36ᵇ</cite> <he>הפ׳ חייבין בערלה</he> pepper-trees are subject to the law of ʿOrlah.
<cite ref="Mishnah Beitzah 2:9">Bets. II, 9</cite> <he>הרחים של פ׳</he> pepper-mill.
<cite ref="Tractate Soferim 15:8">Treat. Sof’rim XV, 8</cite> <he>נמשלה … והמשנה כפ׳</he> the Torah is compared to salt, the Mishnah to pepper.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Horayot 3:5:9">Y. Hor. III, 48ᶜ</cite> top <he>מלח בזול פ׳ ביוקר</he> salt is cheap, pepper is dear; <he>איפשר לעולם … בלא פ׳ וכ׳</he> (not <cite ref="Q01113"><he>פלפילין</he></cite>) the world can live without pepper, but not without salt; a. fr.—[<cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 9:13">Koh. R. to IX, 13</cite>, v. <cite ref="Q00679"><he>פִּילּוֹן</he></cite>.]
